normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Kitchen equipped with Gourmet appliances- Great Porch Space- 4 adult bikes provided- Outdoor Swing Bed- Outdoor Grill - This property comes with 2 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Stay in Watercolor with style, in this lovely two story four bedroom Forest District home. 69 Running Oak boasts beautiful vaulted ceilings, televisions in every bedroom and gourmet appliances throughout the kitchen. Guests can relax and enjoy a coffee or cocktail while sitting on the spacious porches. The front porch boasts a comfy porch swing while the back porch is perfect for outdoor dining. Hop on the 4 bicycles provided to explore Watercolor's quiet streets and winding trails. Enjoy it's close proximity to the Camp Pool, the beach and Seaside. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Bathtub- Bunk Area: Twin over Double Bunk Bed, Shared BathroomWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499 acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Stay in Watercolor with style, in this lovely two story four bedroom Forest District home. 69 Running Oak boasts beautiful vaulted ceilings, televisions in every bedroom and gourmet appliances throughout the kitchen. Guests can relax and enjoy a coffee or cocktail while sitting on the spacious porches. The front porch boasts a comfy porch swing while the back porch is perfect for outdoor dining. Hop on the 4 bicycles provided to explore Watercolor's quiet streets and winding trails. Enjoy it's close proximity to the Camp Pool, the beach and Seaside. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
